analyst.summary: Zee Entertainment's core broadcast business is under genuine pressure -- revenue and margins both fell sharply in the latest year, and the company swung to a net loss -- against a backdrop of a heavily diluted promoter stake and a history of governance concerns. The stock screens as statistically cheap, but we do not think that cheapness reflects durable earnings power, so while our recommendation stays Hold per the fund's scoring rules, we are flagging this internally as a name that may warrant a harder look.
